## Definition of Ready

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are clear and verifiable.
- [ ] Dependencies are identified and resolved (or scheduled earlier).
- [ ] Estimated, and no larger than 8 points.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Code is committed with descriptive message that references this issue.
- [ ] Automated tests or numerical checks pass, with documented tolerances.
- [ ] README or docs are updated if how to run it has changed.
- [ ] Learning notes are written in my own words.
- [ ] It can be demonstrated in the sprint review.
